description: Land Title Settlement Dept - T.R. Haloya Janapadaya, Doluwa D/S/D, Kandy District (25/0394)
categorisation: The gazette content exclusively concerns the declaration of land title determinations for specific parcels of land under the Registration of Title Act. It provides detailed schedules listing parcel numbers, extents, and owners (e.g., "The State", "Land Reforms Commission"), which falls squarely under the definition of Land Gazettes (Type 4) for land registrations, property ownership, and title settlements. There is no mention of government personnel changes, structural reforms, or any other subject matter that would trigger a higher-priority classification.
